items.expected-result: Watch a scratch directory (`settings ingest scope add`, `settings watch enable`, memory_watch_add) holding x.md, w.md and y.md, plus node_modules/pkg/index.md and .git/notes.md, each with a term found nowhere else. Wait for three watch_files rows, `chmod 000` node_modules, wait 2 s, then edit y.md so watches.last_change_ts moves past x.md's watch_files.updated_at. Read both values while the server runs, because a stopped WAL bank will not open read-only. Stop the server. Replace one word of x.md with a new term of the same byte length and `touch -t $(date -r <t> +%Y%m%d%H%M.%S)` it, where t is between x.md's updated_at and last_change_ts. Rewrite w.md at a different size with a new term, and touch it to before its own updated_at. Restart on the same data root. Within seconds memory_search finds both new terms, watch_files shows new updated_at and size for x.md and w.md, and memory_watch_status reads Healthy. Neither the node_modules term nor the .git term is ever found. Premise: before the restart, updated_at(x.md) <= mtime(x.md) <= last_change_ts. A build without ADR-0121 finds neither new term, because it re-queues only files with mtime > last_change_ts. The 5-minute heal pass (WatchHostedService.HealInterval, event 322 at Debug) is optional: it needs a server left up for over 5 minutes (ADR-0121)

items.evidence: premise: x.md updated_at 1792312226 <= mtime 1792312230 <= last_change_ts 1792312249; w.md mtime 200 < updated_at 226. After restart: watch_files x.md updated_at 1792312270 size 18 hash c25d0c3bcb; w.md 1792312270 size 22 hash 7244eac990; independent sha256(path+bytes) x=c25d0c3bcbd2 w=7244eac99088 match. search: xylophonebbb->wc/x.md (fts), walrusnewterm777->wc/w.md (fts), xylophoneaaa [], walrusold111 [], nmzzzterm [], gitzzzterm [], yakyakyak->y.md. status Healthy, skippedCount 0.
items.observed-result: Both missed edits healed after restart; old terms gone; the .git term never found; the node_modules term was also absent, but its decoy was unreadable, so that leg could not fail; y.md control untouched (updated_at 1792312249).
items.acceptance-reason: Premise read and held; both new terms found, both old terms gone, row hashes equal an independent sha256; y.md is the unchanged control; the readable .git decoy was never found. The node_modules leg proves nothing in this run: the decoy was chmod 000, unreadable whether excluded or not (the flaw the 1.57.6 run recorded against 1.57.2). The template step is fixed to keep the decoy readable.

items.evidence: entry section 'cell 1 (markdown) | cell 2 (code) | cell 3 (code) | cell 4 (markdown)', body '## cell 1 (markdown) ... ## cell 2 (code)'. count(value like): frobnicate_quux7731 1, zanzibar 1, fence_inside_cell_ww5512 1, tail_marker_rr3308 1, ctrlmd 1 (control), OUTPUTMARKER_kk9921 0, OUTFIG_pp4410 0, 'iVBOR' 0, base64 png prefix 0. search frobnicate_quux7731 -> nb.ipynb legs [fts rank 1]; 'zanzibar gnomon' -> nb.ipynb fts; OUTPUTMARKER_kk9921 [] ; OUTFIG [] . Fence cell body shows escaped '\```' lines inside an outer fenced cell. big.ipynb 11 chunks, cell-aligned (3 cells each); chunk 6 holds the fence cell: fence=4 unescaped (balanced) esc=2; every chunk even fence count.
items.observed-result: Cells indexed, outputs/attachments/base64 absent, fence in cell escaped and balanced, chunks never split mid-cell.
items.acceptance-reason: Output and attachment markers count 0 next to a control term counting 1; search legs show the FTS hits; fence balance checked in every chunk.

items.expected-result: watch status (CLI and MCP) lists each file the watch cannot index with its reason (binary, unparseable, unsupported-type) and never an indexed file; the list survives a restart, drops a file once it is deleted or fixed, and shows at most 20 entries followed by '… N more'.
items.command: watch wd4 (proj/ctrl.md, nb.ipynb, big.ipynb, broken.ipynb, blob.txt, blob.cs, data.xyzq): watch status CLI + MCP; kill/restart w/o file changes; delete blob.txt; rewrite broken.ipynb valid; add 22 binaries
items.evidence: initial CLI: 'skipped: 4' blob.cs (binary), blob.txt (binary), broken.ipynb (unparseable), data.xyzq (unsupported-type); ctrl.md/nb.ipynb not listed; MCP skippedCount 4 with same reasons. Restart with no file change: immediately 'skipped: 4' identical. Live delete of blob.txt + fixing broken.ipynb: broken.ipynb and blob.txt gone from list, memory_search repaired_nb_ident_ss4417 finds broken.ipynb. With 22 extra binaries: 'skipped: 24', 20 listed then '… 4 more'; MCP skippedCount 24, 20 listed.
items.observed-result: Reasons correct, control not listed, persistence across restart, delete/fix removes entry, cap 20 with '… N more'. (Also: a restart with the files deleted/fixed while the server was down dropped them from the list: 'skipped: 2' after catch-up.)
items.acceptance-reason: Each reason matched to its file; the indexed control files were never listed; the cap was checked with 24 skipped files against the limit of 20.

items.expected-result: Opening a v17 bank with 1.59.0 migrates it to user_version 18, deleting watch_files rows with no backing entries (files the old build skipped) and keeping backed rows, so a re-scan indexes the formerly skipped notebook.
items.command: live bank ~/.ai-raccoon user_version=18 (doctor: 'user_version: 18 (this binary: 18)') so pre-v18 case built: dotnet tool install ai-raccoon --version 1.58.0 --tool-path lane-c/old; serve with it on dr3, MCP memory_watch_add wd6 (backed.md, ctrl.md, old_nb.ipynb, data.xyzq); copy+VACUUM INTO dr4, DELETE FROM watches; serve with 1.59.0; sqlite3
items.evidence: pre (1.58.0 bank, user_version 17): watch_files rows backed.md, ctrl.md, old_nb.ipynb, data.xyzq; entries only backed.md, ctrl.md; code_entries 0; orphans pre = data.xyzq, old_nb.ipynb. After 1.59.0 opened dr4: user_version 18; watch_files = backed.md, ctrl.md; orphans after = 0. Re-adding watch: old_nb.ipynb now indexed as 'cell 1 (markdown) | ...', status 'skipped: 1' data.xyzq (unsupported-type).
items.observed-result: Migration to v18 removed exactly the unbacked rows, kept backed ones, and the notebook was re-scanned and indexed.
items.acceptance-reason: Direct instrument: the live bank is already v18, so a v17 bank was built with the published ai-raccoon 1.58.0 and migrated by 1.59.0 — exactly the upgrade path the item names.

items.expected-result: 1.58.0: the 1Password CLI (op) bank-key source supplies the key and opens an encrypted bank; an op failure is reported as a clear error, not an opened/garbled bank
items.command: fake op script lane-b/fakebin/op first on PATH (--version -> 2.99.0-fake; 'read <ref>' -> prints OpenSSH ed25519 key k1 by default, FAKE_OP_MODE=fail -> stderr error exit 1, otherkey -> key k2); printf 'op://TestVault/BankKey/private key?ssh-format=openssh\n' | ai-raccoon --data-root lane-b/opd encryption 1password; encryption show; serve; MCP write/search; restart variants
items.evidence: config: 'encryption source set to 1password'; show: 'source: 1password / reference: op://TestVault/BankKey/private key?ssh-format=openssh'; op.calls shows 'read op://TestVault/BankKey/private key?ssh-format=openssh'. memory.db not plain sqlite. serve opened it; search 'marigold-basalt-8812' -> 'Op-keyed bank holds marigold-basalt-8812 sentinel.' (also after a restart). fail variant: exit=25 'could not resolve the encryption key: op failed (exit 1): [ERROR] ... not signed in to 1Password'. otherkey: exit=21 'does not open with the resolved encryption key ... key is wrong'. op not on PATH: exit=23 'op not found — install the 1Password CLI (op) and sign in or set OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN'. memory.db sha256 identical before/after the failure variants (09e113ce...)
items.observed-result: op supplies the key, bank opens and persists; op failure/missing/wrong key are clear typed errors with the bank left byte-identical
items.acceptance-reason: Instrument: fake `op` shell script on PATH emitting a throwaway ed25519 key (real 1Password binary, vaults and desktop-app integration not touched). The real-op desktop-app path (ADR-0132 'Manual check required') remains unverified.
